title: gate._run treats PermissionError from os.killpg like ProcessLookupError (macOS EPERM on a zombie-only process group)
spec:
Why: on macOS, os.killpg(pgid, sig) raises PermissionError (EPERM), not ProcessLookupError, when every process left in the group is a zombie. orchestrator/gate.py _run catches only ProcessLookupError around each killpg (lines ~51, 58, 65-66, 71). On 2026-10-01 T-1408's gate went red on tests/test_gate_timeout.py test_cleanup_command_runs_on_timeout with PermissionError at gate.py:65 (the os.killpg(proc.pid, 0) probe after the SIGTERM grace). In production the same race crashes run_gate on a timeout instead of returning timed_out, which the daemon would record as a gate failure.

What: in gate._run treat PermissionError exactly like ProcessLookupError at every os.killpg call (the group is gone or unkillable zombies; reap with proc.wait/communicate as today). Keep the return shape and the wall-clock deadline logic from T-1407. Add the test with os.killpg patched to raise PermissionError on the probe and on SIGKILL: run_bounded on a sleeping child with a tiny timeout returns timed_out True and does not raise.

Work on the task branch cut from goal/T-1403 (after T-1407 merged). Commit first, then run the focused test in the foreground; never background a command, never the full gate.
acceptance: tests/test_gate_timeout.py::test_killpg_permission_error_is_treated_as_gone passes: with os.killpg raising PermissionError for the probe and SIGKILL, run_bounded on a timed-out child returns timed_out True without raising
tests/test_gate_timeout.py passes as a whole, run three times in a row; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh wt/THIS-TASK exits 0
